title: FloodGuard Companion Credit on LandlordGuard Renewals
content:
**Credit terms.** The flood companion credit on a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal paid in full applies to a building the named insured also insures under the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy. A FloodGuard policy in force at the same property address with no flood claim payment on that FloodGuard policy in the tier's claims lookback (36 calendar months on every tier) up to today gives 3 percent; a FloodGuard policy in force at that address with one or more flood claim payments on it in that window gives 1 percent; a building with no FloodGuard policy in force at that address gives 0 percent.

The credit is taken off the account adjustment percentage, which is applied once to the smaller of the indicated renewal premium and the capped expiring premium.

## Conditions in combination

| FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force at the same property address | Flood claim payments on that FloodGuard policy in the 36 calendar months up to today | Flood companion credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 3 percent |
| yes | one or more | 1 percent |
| no (none at that address, or not in force) | — | 0 percent |

## Records read

- The FloodGuard policy's status and property address, matched to the LandlordGuard property address.
- The flood claim payment entries on that FloodGuard policy, each placed in the window by its entry date.

## Hypothetical cases

- A landlord's FloodGuard policy at the rental address is in force and a flood claim was paid on it 14 months ago: 1 percent.
- The FloodGuard policy at that address was cancelled last year: 0 percent.
- A FloodGuard policy in force at a different address of the same landlord: 0 percent for this building.
